verdict.rationale: AI Gateway automatically retries failed requests on other providers. Engineers can shape that failover through provider `order`/`only`/`sort` and per-provider timeouts, and BYOK failures retry with system credentials. It is failover routing, not a configurable retry policy for transient errors. Missing for 10: configurable retry counts, backoff/jitter settings, selection of which error classes count as transient, same-provider retries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can set automatic retry policies for transient provider errors

citations.quote: Automatically retries requests to other providers if one fails
You can set per-provider timeouts to trigger fast failover when a provider is slow to respond.
You can use `order`, `only`, and `sort` in `providerOptions.gateway` to control which providers handle your requests, in what order, and how they are ranked.
If a query using your credentials fails, AI Gateway will retry the query with its system credentials to improve service availability.
